subject: general
question: An area designated for wildlife in which they have unrestricted access to ecosystems and natural resources is called a ______.
solution:
The correct answer is a **national park**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **ecology **is to be preserved via **national parks.**
 
• They participate in public leisure and amusement activities.
 
• The **natural ecosystems **of its flora, animals, and landscapes are preserved in national parks.
 
• **Wildlife in India is very diverse.**
 
• It has about** 7.6% mammals, 6.2% reptiles, 12.6% birds, and 6.0% flowering plant species** under the** Indomalayan ecozone.**
 
• The **Shola woodlands** and other ecoregions of our country exhibit high levels of endemism.
 
• The range of woods includes everything from **coniferous forests **in the **Himalayan region to tropical rainforests, the Western Ghats, and Northeast India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National parks** that are far from populated areas might serve as a haven for **wildlife**.
 
• Currently, India has more than **100 national parks** dispersed across the country's various biomes.
 
• **Hailey National Park **is the country's first national park.
 
• It is one of the outstanding examples of ecological protection.
